prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE wide 3:2 landscape scenic plate, 1536x1024, for Wonder Together's Tiny Guests story. Quiet luxury illustrated picture book: tactile warm ivory paper, delicate ink detail, muted watercolor, cinematic warm morning light, walnut, cream, ink-blue shadows, rare amber-gold. Consistent characters: Big and Little Wonderer are NONHUMAN warm-gray and cream pebble/capsule guides with rounded smooth stone bodies, tiny dot eyes, a tiny horizontal nose dash, very short mitten arms and tiny pebble feet. Big is 1.6 times Little's height and stays calmly nearby. No humans, ears, bears, plush fur, costumes or detailed paws. Same cozy kitchen-study setting: ivory ceramic sink, simple brushed brass faucet, amber glass soap pump, pale linen towel, walnut counter, a small book of friendly tiny guests, occasional brass magnifier and plain yogurt cup. Bacterium represented on book pages as a soft sage oval whole cell. Virus shown on book pages as a MUCH SMALLER soft ochre round package with a curled thread inside and only gentle rounded nubs, no sharp spikes. Both friendly and simple, no menace. Magnifier alone must not reveal microbes on real skin. No text, letters, titles, labels, arrows, answer diagrams, panels, borders, giant hands, tip-hand, logos or watermark. No illness, treatment, medicine, needles, hospitals, gore, war or fear. Scenic apparatus and a tender shared moment dominate. Opening/title-card scenic image. Wide establishing view of the walnut counter beside the ivory sink, with amber soap pump and a neatly folded linen towel. Big and Little stand near a brass magnifier lying flat beside an open natural-history book. The book has two tiny muted unlabeled shapes drawn on its pages, one larger sage oval and one much smaller ochre dot. Little looks curiously between the magnifier and the book, arms relaxed. Gentle window light from left, spacious calm anticipation. No microbes floating in the kitchen or on skin.
